hero.title: Revolutionizing Pharmaceutical Automation
hero.description: Our four-axis robotic arms are designed to enhance efficiency and precision in the medical field.

about.mission: To innovate and provide cutting-edge robotic solutions for the pharmaceutical industry.
about.vision: To be a leader in automation technology, improving productivity and safety in medical applications.
about.companyIntro: ZeroAnt Technology is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of micro-logistics intelligent conveying systems. We are committed to connecting professional equipment and application scenarios through innovative intelligent logistics solutions, helping various industries achieve efficient and reliable intelligent upgrades. Our core team consists of researchers from Beihang University and industry experts, with profound technical expertise and rich engineering experience.
about.culture: Driven by innovation, extremely reliable, and win-win cooperation. We insist on customer-centricity, continuously promote technological innovation, and strive to become a leader in the field of micro-logistics intelligence.

timeline.2017: Started robot operating system R&D, received national project support of 24.14 million
timeline.2020: Company founded, focusing on micro-logistics intelligent conveying system R&D
timeline.2022: Completed multiple industry intelligent logistics projects, team size exceeded 18 people
timeline.2024: Released AiROS robot operating system, won ACM MobiCom 2024 Best Technical Achievement Award, expert panel rated technology as internationally leading
timeline.2025: Officially established Hangzhou ZeroAnt Technology Co., Ltd., orders in hand 16 million, planned financing 20 million, preliminary valuation 200 million RMB

about.honor3: Multiple Invention Patents and Software Copyrights
about.honor4: Industry Innovation Award, Technology Breakthrough Award
about.teamInfo: Team size: 18 people, 94% with master's degree or above, average age 30, 90% from top universities
about.marketInfo: In 2024, the global industrial robot market is about $70 billion, and the total potential market size of embodied robots is about $60 trillion.
about.financing: Plans to divest 10% equity, raise 20 million yuan, preliminary valuation of 200 million yuan.
